text: A storm leaves a party of day trippers [stranded on a deserted island|trigger|cut off and trapped] whose rain-soaked forest is crowded with unusually large mushrooms. On a wrecked ship coated in mold, the professor Murai reads a log warning that the mushrooms bring hallucinations, and as food runs low the castaways turn on one another. Those who give in and eat [become humanoid mushroom creatures|ending|victims become the evil], and the fungus [spreads through the dripping trees|images|plants, trees and fungus] toward whoever is left.
